Install claude-code on Omarchy

Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool: you run it from a project directory and describe what you want in plain language, and it reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and handles git workflows like commits and PRs on your behalf. It runs primarily as a terminal CLI but also integrates with IDEs and GitHub (by tagging @claude on issues or PRs).

Watch: How we Claude Code ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add claude-code
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2.1.307-1:
    pacman -Qi claude-code

Open and use claude-code

claude-code has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql claude-code | grep /usr/bin/

claude-code requirements and compatibility

  • a Claude.ai account or Anthropic API key
  • network access to reach Anthropic's API

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • bash

Frequently asked questions

How do I install claude-code on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add claude-code. The download is 126.3 MB and it takes 292 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is claude-code free?

Usable with a Claude.ai subscription (Pro/Max) or pay-as-you-go Anthropic API credits; the official site did not surface exact figures during this review. The package is licensed LicenseRef-claude-code.

How do I uninstall claude-code?

Run omarchy pkg drop claude-code. It removes the package from your system.

What does claude-code depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: bash. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is claude-code a desktop app?

No. claude-code has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is claude-code in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as claude-code (version 2.1.307-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Anthropic makes it. Project site: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code.
